notes.title: Added endings for the arcade version.
notes.content:
Added an ending for the arcade version.
Options Menu > Game Settings > Ending mode
You can now choose between the Consumer and Arcade sections.

In addition, minor bugs have been fixed.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Fixed a bug with achievements
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented some achievements from being retrieved.

We'll keep checking the forums and continue to update.
And we have some updates in mind.
Thank you for your continued support.
